title: Law to require notice before evicting older tenants
summary: This bill would require landlords to notify the city Department of Housing Preservation and Development before starting eviction proceedings against tenants aged 60 or older. The department would then send the tenant a list of legal aid resources and would report annually, by July 1, on eviction trends and patterns of discrimination against older tenants. Violating the notification requirement would be a class A misdemeanor.
